Name: Wizard Portrait and Sprite Replacement
Author: Adree23
Description:
[s][center][/center]
[/s][s]Harvest Moon Animal Parade is the reason why I'm like this.[/s] I made this for fun for myself originally since I am on a mission to romance any and every wizard that shows up in a farming simulator, I guess. I'm a pretty sad excuse for a human being. I meant for the portraits to still have similar looks to the original, though. Kinda. Anyway, I just decided to upload this here because why not.

[b]How to Install (I'm not an expert on modding so this may not be the most efficient):[/b]

[list]
[*]Unzip the folder labelled Liorlen - Wizard Character Mod and go into the Content folder. The other folder is just the .png files of the sprites and portraits.
[/list]
[list]
[*]There will be two folders: Portraits and Characters.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Go into the Characters folder and copy Wizard.xnb and then go to C:\Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content. If you can't find this, your Stardew Valley folder may be in a different place such as Program Files (x86). Open the Characters folder there and paste Wizard.xnb and let it replace the file that was already there.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Go back to the mod folders and go into the Portraits folder. Copy Wizard.xnb. Go back to C:\Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content and open the Portraits folder. Paste Wizard.xnb and let it replace the file that was there.
[/list]
[b]
[/b][b]This is compatible with [/b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/366/]Siv's Marriage Mod[/url]. [/b]If you don't have it downloaded, you'll be fine, although I will be wondering why you're looking at this mod then. 

[b]If you have any issues please tell me. [/b]And if you like this mod, please let me know! I know this isn't for everyone, it's just what I decided to go with.


I have been considering making other portrait mods, although I'm not sure about it. We'll see I guess. I just made this for fun in the first place.[b]﻿
Thank you for reading![/b]
